root_cause.cause: Release proof had multiple orchestration owners instead of one change-scoped aggregate owner.
contributing_factors: Netlify parity existed in both Required preflight and the website release lane.
Supabase Preview Applicability was branch-protection-required for every PR rather than only database-relevant changes.

prevention.rule: One proof owner per concern on the PR critical path.
prevention.netlify: Preserve the existing single Netlify parity owner; do not introduce a second owner in the website lane.
prevention.supabase: Required test invokes provider preview proof only for database-relevant Supabase source.
prevention.invariant: Do not remove provider proof from protection until the equivalent proof is represented inside the canonical Required aggregate.
